ESIC Medical College and Hospital Ranchi Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 85 Professor, Associate Professor and More Posts - Complete Details

ESIC Medical College and Hospital Ranchi has released the new notification for the recruitment of Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Senior Resident New Vacancy 2026 for 85 Posts. The offline application process closes on 21 September 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, esic.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Notification date : 16 September 2026
  • Last date for receipt of application : 21 September 2026
  • Tentative interview date : 30 September 2026 or the other date communicated by ESIC
  • SC, ST, female candidates, Defence ex-servicemen and PH candidates : Nil

Application Fee

  • Institution : ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Ranchi
  • Post Names : Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Senior Resident
  • Last date for receipt of application : 21 September 2026
  • Post Name : Number of Vacancies
  • Assistant Professor : 16
  • Post : Maximum Age
  • Assistant Professor : Not exceeding 69 years
  • Post Name : Basic Consolidated Remuneration
  • Assistant Professor : ₹67,700
  • SC, ST, female candidates, Defence ex-servicemen and PH candidates : Nil
  • Postal/Hand Delivery Address : Dean, ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Purulia Road, Namkum, Ranchi – 834010, Jharkhand

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
